import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import os
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.naive_bayes import MultinomialNB
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.metrics import log_loss

# Load data
train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")
sample_sub = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission.csv")


# Text preprocessing function
def clean_text(text):
    """Basic text cleaning"""
    if isinstance(text, str):
        return " ".join(text.split())
    return str(text)


# Clean training text
train_df["text_clean"] = train_df["text"].apply(clean_text)
test_df["text_clean"] = test_df["text_clean"].apply(clean_text)

# Create stratified train/validation split (80/20)
train_val, val = train_test_split(
    train_df, test_size=0.2, random_state=42, stratify=train_df["author"]
)

# TF-IDF Feature Extraction optimized for word-level discrimination
tfidf = TfidfVectorizer(
    max_features=15000,
    ngram_range=(1, 2),
    min_df=1,
    max_df=0.95,
    strip_accents="unicode",
    lowercase=True,
    sublinear_tf=True,
)

X_train = tfidf.fit_transform(train_val["text_clean"])
X_val = tfidf.transform(val["text_clean"])

y_train = train_val["author"].map({"EAP": 0, "HPL": 1, "MWS": 2})
y_val = val["author"].map({"EAP": 0, "HPL": 1, "MWS": 2})

# Train ensemble of two diverse classifiers
clf_nb = MultinomialNB(alpha=0.1)
clf_nb.fit(X_train, y_train)

clf_lr = LogisticRegression(C=0.5, max_iter=1000, solver="lbfgs", random_state=42)
clf_lr.fit(X_train, y_train)

# Validation prediction probabilities from both models
val_proba_nb = clf_nb.predict_proba(X_val)
val_proba_lr = clf_lr.predict_proba(X_val)

# Average ensemble probabilities
val_proba_ensemble = (val_proba_nb + val_proba_lr) / 2


# Multi-class log loss calculation (matching competition formula)
def compute_log_loss(y_true_series, y_proba):
    eps = 1e-15
    p_clamped = np.clip(y_proba, eps, 1 - eps)
    N = len(y_true_series)
    classes = ["EAP", "HPL", "MWS"]
    loss = 0.0
    for i in range(N):
        true_label = y_true_series.iloc[i]
        for j in range(len(classes)):
            y_ij = 1.0 if classes[j] == true_label else 0.0
            loss += -y_ij * np.log(p_clamped[i][j])
    return loss / N


logloss = compute_log_loss(val.reset_index(drop=True)["author"], val_proba_ensemble)
print(f"{logloss:.6f}")

# Generate test predictions
test_X = tfidf.transform(test_df["text_clean"])
test_proba_nb = clf_nb.predict_proba(test_X)
test_proba_lr = clf_lr.predict_proba(test_X)

# Average ensemble probabilities for test set
test_proba_ensemble = (test_proba_nb + test_proba_lr) / 2

# Format submission
submission = pd.DataFrame(
    {
        "id": test_df["id"],
        "EAP": [p[0] for p in test_proba_ensemble],
        "HPL": [p[1] for p in test_proba_ensemble],
        "MWS": [p[2] for p in test_proba_ensemble],
    }
)

os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)
submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
